sources.title: Custom Updates
sources.summary: SDK custom-update templates are declared under instant_games.custom_update_templates in the uploaded game manifest. Each identifier requires an example string. The SDK uses the same identifier and supplies actual translated text and opaque entry data.

sources.title: Custom Updates, Invites, and Shares
sources.summary: updateAsync targets the current context. Entry data is limited to 1000 serialized characters. NO_PUSH is available. This older guide refers to dashboard templates, while the newer retention guide specifies the bundle configuration.
